title: Rafael and the Thorn
author: Rafael Nakamura
blurb: Jonah Whitlock, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
